question: Has gap G003 already been addressed: The value of peripheral (non-answer-chain) context triples has been tested only at inference time, where they are nearly inert (+0.003 F1) and inflated context adds accuracy-depressing distractors. No retrieved study tests whether peripheral context triples contribute to the learned representation during training, or whether they are simply noise that also harms training.?
rationale: A gap is only a hypothesis until a targeted search fails to find work that closes it.
